subject: Urgent: Evidence & access checklist for FT-358 error/latency spike
messages:
From: Elena Moro <elena@fastretail.io>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@fastretail.io
Date: 2028-11-19T10:12:00Z
Subject: Major spike in errors/latency across checkout - immediate evidence request

Hi Naomi,

We observed a sharp spike in 5xx errors and token-level latency on our checkout flows starting ~2028-11-19T09:48Z. This is customer impacting — conversion dropped and the ops team is seeing timeouts from the Redwood inference endpoints.

We need the following ASAP for our incident report and potential legal review:
- Raw runtime logs (token-level traces) for 2028-11-19T09:40Z through 2028-11-19T10:10Z
- Any routing/fallback events (model variant or region failover)
- Evidence of retention/handling: when logs are archived, where they are stored, and who accessed them

Our CTO is asking for an evidence bundle and chain-of-custody statement; please tell us ETA. We are escalating internally and may require this for a compliance audit.

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Moro
Head of Platform Ops, FastRetail

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: Elena Moro <elena@fastretail.io>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-11-19T10:25:00Z
Subject: Re: Major spike in errors/latency across checkout - immediate evidence request

Elena — thanks for the heads up and sorry for the impact. We have an active incident on our side and I'm looping in the runtime and compliance leads.

Quick plan:
- Marcus, can you capture the token-level traces and export the runtime logs for 09:40–10:10Z and package them as an evidence bundle (include MD5 checksums)?
- Stephanie, please advise redaction/PII steps and whether we should provide raw logs or a sanitized package first.
- Evelyn, I'll coordinate customer comms and timeline.

We will preserve the exact bucket/object names and start a legal hold. I'll confirm ETA within 45 minutes.

Naomi Feldman
Head of Customer Reliability, Redwood Inference
naomi@redwood.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-11-19T10:42:00Z
Subject: Re: Major spike in errors/latency across checkout - immediate evidence request

On Mon, 2028-11-19 at 10:25, Naomi Feldman wrote:
> Elena — thanks for the heads up and sorry for the impact. We have an active incident on our side and I'm looping in the runtime and compliance leads.

I pulled the runtime traces and an initial packet of artifacts. Attached:
- runtime-sample-logs.txt (token-level excerpts, truncated for size)
- fastretail_error_window_1119.zip (bundled logs + routing events + worker metrics)

Notes:
- The error spike maps to a brief fallback from model-redwood-v2 to redwood-v2-quant at 09:49:12Z due to a transient OOM on a single host. We saw increased queueing for ~18s.
- Logs include request_ids and session prefixes. I have not redacted anything — this is the raw export.
- Export path: s3://redwood-incident-exports/fastretail/FT-358/20281119/ (objects have SHA256 checksums).

Next steps I recommend: take a snapshot of the full object list (for chain-of-custody), and if we are sharing with FastRetail, decide whether to redact session-level tokens first per Stephanie's guidance.

Marcus
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-11-19T11:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Major spike in errors/latency across checkout - immediate evidence request

On Mon, 2028-11-19 at 10:42, Marcus Lin wrote:
> I pulled the runtime traces and an initial packet of artifacts. Attached: runtime-sample-logs.txt, fastretail_error_window_1119.zip

Thanks — do not share raw logs externally until we confirm the DPA/NDA and scope. Quick checklist for the internal redaction decision: 
- Do logs contain PII (names, email addresses, payment tokens)? If yes, we need to either redact or provide a pseudonymized extract.
- Provide a mapping of what we would redact and an estimated sanitized artifact size.
- If customer requires raw logs for legal reasons, we will prepare a controlled transfer with an evidence manifest and audit of access.

Attached: log-redaction-guidance.pdf (internal) — it lists fields we regularly remove and recommended hashing strategies.

I will start a Legal Hold entry and notify the security team. Estimated time to prepare a sanitized package: 2–3 hours. To package a full raw evidence bundle with chain-of-custody statements and signatures: 8–12 hours.

Stephanie Nguyen
Sr. Privacy & Compliance Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Elena Moro <elena@fastretail.io>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@fastretail.io, cto@fastretail.io
Date: 2028-11-19T12:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Major spike in errors/latency across checkout - immediate evidence request

Naomi — thanks for the quick triage and to Marcus + Stephanie for the detail. Our CTO wants the raw evidence bundle (unredacted) for an internal compliance review and will sign an evidence transfer agreement.

Can you confirm:
- ETA to deliver the full raw bundle with checksums and chain-of-custody statement?
- Will you provide a signed manifest and a list of Redwood staff who will have access during packaging?
- We need the artifact delivered to a secure shared location (we prefer an S3 presigned object or a secure Drive link).

We have a DocuSign link ready for the evidence transfer agreement: https://docusign.com/FT-358-evidence-nda

Elena

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-11-20T15:40:00Z
Subject: Executive summary & next steps — FastRetail (FT-358) evidence package

Team — sending an executive summary for leadership and an ask to proceed with evidence packaging per FastRetail's request. Attachments: SLA-uptime-report.pdf, incident-evidence-bundle-FT-358.tar.gz (staged, encrypted).

Summary:
- Root cause (prelim): transient OOM on a single host triggered a model variant fallback at 09:49:12Z, causing ~18s of increased queueing and elevated 5xxs.
- Artifacts captured: token-level traces, routing/fallback logs, worker-level metrics, and S3 export objects with SHA256 checksums.
- Chain-of-custody: snapshot of s3://redwood-incident-exports/fastretail/FT-358/20281119/ created at 2028-11-19T11:00:00Z; access grants recorded; audit entries retained.

Action items:
1) Marcus — finalize the raw evidence bundle, include MD5/SHA256 checksums, and prepare transfer mechanics (presigned S3 link + time-bound access). ETA: 8 hours.
2) Stephanie — complete Legal Hold & approve transfer under DPA + evidence agreement; confirm redaction policy if needed. ETA: 4 hours.
3) Evelyn — coordinate a short customer update once transfer is staged; propose a CEO-level exec update template.

Please reply with confirmations. If we get sign-off, I will authorize the secure transfer to FastRetail and add the signatory entries to the manifest.

Naomi Feldman
Head of Customer Reliability, Redwood Inference
naomi@redwood.com
